criteria.description: The bounded direct confirmed-PIX command satisfies its atomicity, exact-value, idempotency, concurrency, tenant-isolation, append-only proof and no-cash-movement acceptance contract.
criteria.limitations: Acceptance applies only to direct execution inside the tenant UoW with a durable completed PIX transaction; HTTP/provider/worker/SPA behavior is not part of this criterion.

criteria.description: Focused database, cash/PIX, route, repository and consumer regressions plus the full API suite, global coverage and static security checks are current and passing.
criteria.limitations: The current pass does not replace the complete browser, provider-sandbox, card, inventory, deployment or release regression gates.

criteria.description: The verified boundary, excluded higher-risk surfaces and revalidation triggers are explicit; no production, release or provider authority is inferred.
criteria.limitations: CVG-002B2 and later milestones require new gates; the parent CVG-002 task, Quality Bar and release remain PARTIAL or unverified.

authority.decision: No additional human acceptance is required to record the executed local DB-core verification; excluded provider, production and release decisions remain separately governed.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on any command, schema, reconciliation-policy or test-harness mutation and before CVG-002B2, provider, production or release use.

next_action: Freeze a separate CVG-002B2 contract and implementation-ready gate for signed callback, durable dispatch/worker restart and coherent SPA PIX integration.
revalidation_triggers: The confirmed-PIX command, migration, proof schema or reconciliation policy changes
A later focused, integration, API, coverage or security check fails
HTTP callback, provider dispatch, worker restart, real credentials, SPA, card, inventory, production or release enters the claimed scope
